searchText: Hey all, if there is any execution client with 4788 implemented let me know your branch, I have some hive tests for verification of the new Engine API methods but have not been able to test my tests 🙂 it looks like the execution tests have moved from `https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/main/fillers/cancun/eip4844_blobs/blob_txs.py` (for example). I ran into this while trying to run hive locally, and all my tests are failing and those test links are all 404ing. This was running off of the master branch of hive. Is there another branch we should be using to make sure clients are passing hive prior to devnet8? The test files moved from `fillers` to `tests`, and the files now all have `test_` prefix, so the new path is https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/main/tests/cancun/eip4844_blobs/test_blob_txs.py We need to refill them all with 4788 still and update the pyspec sim, please try these branches for the engine api checks: - without 4788: https://github.com/marioevz/hive/tree/engine-api-blobs - with 4788: https://github.com/marioevz/hive/tree/engine-api-blobs-beacon-root Run either of them using: ``` ./hive --sim ethereum/engine --sim.limit "engine-blobs/" --client-file ./configs/4844.yaml --client <the client> ``` We need to refill them all with 4788
